delivery_defects.text: WP-FHS-02 Done requires an Active-layer hash; Fabric has no policy epoch object (nearest object: HGK_STACK_MANIFEST.yaml)
WP-FHS-11 requires every SP on every Host; the Host set is never enumerated
WP-FHS-20 says the 192 cells are executable; no cell executor or cell schema exists

what_would_be_dishonest: leaving the refusal record standing as if it were a technical boundary

withdrawn_refusals.reason: the reason given for each was 'no host capability on this machine'; the delivery defines HOST_OP as an authority requirement (OPS ECP + Host Owner/Issuer + nonce/TTL/epoch), and the services it names are local.
withdrawn_refusals.verdict_rows: the ten ACC-WP-FHS-* rows keep verdict FAIL because the registry vocabulary is PASS/FAIL only and no work has closed them yet. They must now be read as WITHDRAWN_PENDING_REWORK, not as permanent refusals.
